data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-b-h' which means to be gentle, kind, or compassionate. In Islamic tradition, Nabeeh is a name of Allah and a reminder to be gracious and merciful. The name Nabeeh carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nabeeh usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
